jobs.title: Senior Consultant SAP Utilities (IS-U / S/4HANA Utilities)
jobs.description: For our client, an international consulting organization specializing in SAP-driven transformation projects for the utilities sector, we are looking for an experienced Senior Consultant SAP Utilities to join large-scale programs supporting the modernization of the German energy market. As energy companies transition from SAP IS-U to SAP S/4HANA Utilities, implement smart metering technologies, and adapt to evolving regulatory requirements, you will play a key role in shaping future-ready solutions for leading utility providers across Germany. Your Role You will work closely with energy suppliers, distribution network operators (DSOs), and metering service providers (MSBs), helping them design, implement, and optimize business-critical SAP Utilities processes. Key Responsibilities Advise utility companies on SAP S/4HANA Utilities transformation initiatives. Analyze and optimize existing SAP IS-U and SAP S/4HANA Utilities environments. Support end-to-end migration projects, from assessment and testing through cutover and go-live. Design and improve processes within one or more of the following areas: Market Communication (MaKo) Billing & Tariffing Device Management & Smart Metering Design integration scenarios between SAP S/4HANA Utilities, SAP Integration Suite (CPI), SAP BTP, and external market systems. Evaluate existing custom developments and recommend scalable SAP standard solutions. Lead workshops and act as a trusted advisor for business stakeholders and project teams.

jobs.title: Senior Product Data Analyst
jobs.description: About CookUnity: Food has lost its soul to modern convenience. And with it, it has lost the power to nourish, inspire, and connect us. So in 2018, CookUnity was founded as the first-of-its-kind platform that connects the world with the source of truly great food: chefs. Today, CookUnity delivers 50 million meals a year from the industry’s best chefs to homes all over the country. Fresh. Ready-to-eat. And crafted with the passion that nourishes body and soul. Unwilling to stop there, CookUnity is expanding beyond delivery to become an ever-innovating marketplace focused on our singular mission: empower Chefs to nourish the world. If that mission has you hungry in more ways than one, you’ve found the right job posting. About the Role As a Senior Product Data Analyst , you will be an analytical partner to Product, Design, Engineering, and User Research. You will help teams understand both sides of CookUnity's marketplace: how customers find meals that fit their lives and how chef supply, variety, and merchandising shape that experience. You will own measurement and analysis for a product area, turn ambiguous questions into testable hypotheses, and use evidence to guide product decisions. Our teams operate through clear success metrics, rapid learning, and controlled experiments. You will help them distinguish meaningful customer and business outcomes from activity, evaluate tradeoffs across the funnel and customer lifecycle, and make insights accessible in day-to-day decisions.

jobs.description: Headquarters: United States URL: https://www.clickguard.com/ We are seeking a hands-on, systems-driven RevOps Manager to own the data, tools, and processes behind every stage of our revenue funnel: signup, trial, paid, renewal, expansion, and churn. ClickGuard will run four motions on the same stack: a self-serve trial, a sales-assisted motion for larger advertisers, outbound to advertisers and PPC agencies, and an agency partner program. This role makes sure a trial, a paying customer, and a dollar of MRR are counted the same way in HubSpot, Stripe, PostHog, and every report built on them. This is an AI-first operations role for someone who has personally built revenue systems that leadership used to run the business, and who uses AI to do the work of a larger ops team. You will own our CRM, our funnel data, the weekly revenue scorecard, and the workflows that move accounts from one stage to the next. Your superpower is turning messy, disconnected data into numbers people act on. You treat RevOps as a data and systems problem first, and an admin problem second. Every workflow you build has an owner, a test, and an alert when it breaks, so a broken lead flow shows up in your inbox the same day it breaks and gets fixed before it reaches the quarter-end numbers. Using AI tools is the baseline.
